scope: Relevant primary research available by2026-10-20, emphasizing fixedQwen2.5-3B, reasoning data selection and preservation; not an exhaustive or globally ranked state-of-the-art survey.

papers.mechanism: Selects the highest target-model likelihood response among alternatives to the same instruction.
papers.transfer_limit: Our source has one response per question; cross-question NLL ranking is an adaptation, not a reproduction. Use within topic and length strata.

papers.mechanism: Projected, optimizer-aware gradient similarity to task-development examples selects targeted instruction data.
papers.transfer_limit: Warm-up and per-example backward passes are expensive under the remaining budget; needs trustworthy independent development labels.

papers.mechanism: Selects through clustering loss trajectories from a smaller proxy model.
papers.transfer_limit: Endpoint probe loss reduction is not a reproduction. Repeated scans and short-context original experiments limit transfer.

papers.mechanism: Uses relative reference-model loss improvement as a model-specific data-selection signal.
papers.transfer_limit: Close to the signal already tested. Loss reduction alone did not establish useful free-generation behavior in our experiment.

papers.mechanism: Uses early reasoning-token losses under perturbations for difficulty and gradient-related diversity signals.
papers.transfer_limit: Requires a usable fine-tuning trajectory and multiple scoring passes. Evidence is mainly 7B/8B, not our exact3B assignment.

papers.mechanism: Investigates transfer of branching-heavy reasoning behavior and filters highly branching trajectories.
papers.transfer_limit: English keyword density is a diagnostic proxy, not proof of invalid reasoning. Length-only pruning is not equivalent and can harm results.

papers.mechanism: Documents limited-data long-CoT degradation in small models, including Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.
papers.transfer_limit: Supports a mismatch hypothesis, not a diagnosis of our implementation. More training on our fixed15K is not demonstrated to repair it.

papers.method: Small Models Struggle to Learn from Strong Reasoners
papers.mechanism: Studies small-student learnability and mixed short/long reasoning supervision.
papers.transfer_limit: Changing or generating traces is a separate data intervention; retain original-pair provenance in the main assignment arm.

papers.mechanism: Reports that useful response likelihood depends on student capacity and training duration.
papers.transfer_limit: Avoid a universal lowest-loss or hardest-data rule. Same-question alternative-response experiments differ from our source.

papers.mechanism: Adds frozen-base forward KL regularization to detached online-probability-weighted dynamic SFT.
papers.transfer_limit: A training objective, not posthoc weight blending. Adds a reference forward and memory; does not win universally across settings.

papers.mechanism: Derives token weights from the frozen starting model, using probability or cumulative probability mass.
papers.transfer_limit: Can cache reference information, but normalization and effective update magnitude must be controlled. Published models and protocols differ.

papers.mechanism: Preserves the projected top-singular-vector block of pretrained matrices during SFT.
papers.transfer_limit: Includes the exact3B model family but still has per-task regressions. SVD setup and regularizer integration consume scarce implementation/compute budget.

papers.mechanism: Credits tokens by frozen-reference task-conditioned versus erased-input likelihood contrast, with a detached projected-policy weight.
papers.transfer_limit: Very recent. Main1.5B Pass@16 58.6 disagrees with matching appendix configurations56.7. Requires two cached passes; no directly comparable3B assignment result.

papers.mechanism: Filters self-generated responses for correctness and conciseness before SFT.
papers.transfer_limit: Requires rollouts and reliable correctness labels; extra generation and altered targets make it a separate, less affordable arm.

papers.mechanism: Finds that many self-scoring selectors struggle against random on large pools, with diversity and length important.
papers.transfer_limit: Supports strong controls and realistic selection claims; million-scale general SFT evidence is not an exact AceReason15K experiment.

papers.mechanism: Uses a validation-gradient subspace to account for coupled LoRA optimization geometry.
papers.transfer_limit: Potentially cheaper than LESS in its setting; still needs gradient computation, reliable validation and a transfer test to fullSFT.

existing_evidence.diagnosis: No demonstrated masking/accumulation/precision/consumption bug. Learned generation collapse and distribution mismatch are leading hypotheses, not established causes.

recommendation.selection: Complete original traces; audit branching structure and base compatibility within topic/length strata; preserve coverage.
recommendation.training: Pilot a frozen-base-regularized SFT objective before one final fullSFT candidate.
recommendation.scientific_claim: Synthesis of published ideas; novelty and superiority unestablished.
recommendation.evaluation: Fresh independently labeled development and disjoint confirmation; unchanged assignment benchmark protocol; disclose all prior benchmark exposure.
